verses.literal: Then Job replied to the LORD . . .
verses.literalPt: ENTÃO respondeu Jó ao SENHOR, dizendo:

verses.original: יָדַעְתָּ כִּי־ כֹ֣ל תּוּכָ֑ל וְלֹא־ יִבָּצֵ֖ר מִמְּךָ֣ מְזִמָּֽה׃
verses.transliteration: yå̄·ḏaʿ·tå̄ kî- ḵōl tū·ḵāl wə·lō- yib·bā·ṣêr mim·mə·ḵā mə·zim·māh
verses.literal: I know that You can do all things and that no plan of Yours can be thwarted
verses.literalPt: Bem sei eu que tudo podes, e que nenhum dos teus propósitos pode ser impedido.

verses.original: מִ֤י זֶ֨ה׀ מַעְלִ֥ים עֵצָ֗ה בְּֽלִ֫י דָ֥עַת לָכֵ֣ן הִ֭גַּדְתִּי וְלֹ֣א אָבִ֑ין נִפְלָא֥וֹת מִ֝מֶּ֗נִּי וְלֹ֣א אֵדָֽע׃
verses.transliteration: mî zeh ma‘·lîm ‘ê·ṣāh bə·lî ḏā·‘aṯ lā·ḵên hig·gaḏ·tî wə·lō ’ā·ḇîn nip̄·lā·’ō·wṯ mim·men·nî wə·lō ’ê·ḏā‘
verses.literal: You asked, ‘Who is this who conceals My counsel without knowledge Surely I spoke of things I did not understand things too wonderful for me . . . to know
verses.literalPt: Quem é este, que sem conhecimento encobre o conselho? Por isso relatei o que não entendia; coisas que para mim eram inescrutáveis, e que eu não entendia.

verses.original: שְֽׁמַֽע־ נָ֭א וְאָנֹכִ֣י אֲדַבֵּ֑ר אֶ֝שְׁאָלְךָ֗ וְהוֹדִיעֵֽנִי׃
verses.literal: You said, ‘Listen now and I will speak I will question you and you shall inform Me
verses.literalPt: Escuta-me, pois, e eu falarei; eu te perguntarei, e tu me ensinarás.

verses.original: לְשֵֽׁמַע־ אֹ֥זֶן שְׁמַעְתִּ֑יךָ וְ֝עַתָּ֗ה עֵינִ֥י רָאָֽתְךָ׃
verses.literal: My ears . . . had heard of You but now my eyes have seen You
verses.literalPt: Com o ouvir dos meus ouvidos ouvi, mas agora te vêem os meus olhos.

verses.original: עַל־ כֵּ֭ן אֶמְאַ֣ס וְנִחַ֑מְתִּי עַל־ עָפָ֥ר וָאֵֽפֶר׃פ
verses.literal: Therefore . . . I despise myself and I repent in dust and ashes
verses.literalPt: Por isso me abomino e me arrependo no pó e na cinza.

verses.original: וַיְהִ֗י אַחַ֨ר דִּבֶּ֧ר יְהוָ֛ה אֶת־ הַדְּבָרִ֥ים הָאֵ֖לֶּה אֶל־ אִיּ֑וֹב וַיֹּ֨אמֶר יְהוָ֜ה אֶל־ אֱלִיפַ֣ז הַתֵּֽימָנִ֗י חָרָ֨ה אַפִּ֤י בְךָ֙ וּבִשְׁנֵ֣י רֵעֶ֔יךָ כִּ֠י לֹ֣א דִבַּרְתֶּ֥ם אֵלַ֛י נְכוֹנָ֖ה כְּעַבְדִּ֥י אִיּֽוֹב׃
verses.transliteration: way·hî ’a·ḥar dib·ber Yah·weh ’eṯ- had·də·ḇā·rîm hā·’êl·leh ’el- ’î·yō·wḇ way·yō·mer Yah·weh ’el- ’ĕ·lî·p̄az hat·tê·mā·nî ḥā·rāh ’ap·pî ḇə·ḵā ū·ḇiš·nê rê·‘e·ḵā kî lō ḏib·bar·tem ’ê·lay nə·ḵō·w·nāh kə·‘aḇ·dî ’î·yō·wḇ
verses.literal: After the LORD had spoken these words to Job He said to Eliphaz the Temanite My wrath is kindled against you and your two friends For you have not spoken about Me accurately as My servant Job has
verses.literalPt: Sucedeu que, acabando o SENHOR de falar a Jó aquelas palavras, o SENHOR disse a Elifaz, o temanita: A minha ira se acendeu contra ti, e contra os teus dois amigos, porque não falastes de mim o que era reto, como o meu servo Jó.

verses.original: וְעַתָּ֡ה קְחֽוּ־ לָכֶ֣ם שִׁבְעָֽה־ פָרִים֩ וְשִׁבְעָ֨ה אֵילִ֜ים וּלְכ֣וּ׀ אֶל־ עַבְדִּ֣י אִיּ֗וֹב וְהַעֲלִיתֶ֤ם עוֹלָה֙ בַּֽעַדְכֶ֔ם וְאִיּ֣וֹב עַבְדִּ֔י יִתְפַּלֵּ֖ל עֲלֵיכֶ֑ם כִּ֧י אִם־ פָּנָ֣יו אֶשָּׂ֗א לְבִלְתִּ֞י עֲשׂ֤וֹת עִמָּכֶם֙ נְבָלָ֔ה כִּ֠י לֹ֣א דִבַּרְתֶּ֥ם אֵלַ֛י נְכוֹנָ֖ה כְּעַבְדִּ֥י אִיּֽוֹב׃
verses.transliteration: wə·‘at·tāh qə·ḥū- lā·ḵem šiḇ·‘āh- p̄ā·rîm wə·šiḇ·‘āh ’ê·lîm ū·lə·ḵū ’el- ‘aḇ·dî ’î·yō·wḇ wə·ha·‘ă·lî·ṯem ‘ō·w·lāh ba·‘aḏ·ḵem wə·’î·yō·wḇ ‘aḇ·dî yiṯ·pal·lêl ‘ă·lê·ḵem kî ’im- pā·nāw ’eś·śā lə·ḇil·tî ‘ă·śō·wṯ ‘im·mā·ḵem nə·ḇā·lāh kî lō ḏib·bar·tem ’ê·lay nə·ḵō·w·nāh kə·‘aḇ·dî ’î·yō·wḇ
verses.literal: So now take seven bulls and seven rams go to My servant Job and sacrifice a burnt offering for yourselves Then My servant Job will pray for you for . . . I will accept his prayer and not deal with you according to your folly For you have not spoken accurately about Me as My servant Job has
verses.literalPt: Tomai, pois, sete bezerros e sete carneiros, e ide ao meu servo Jó, e oferecei holocaustos por vós, e o meu servo Jó orará por vós; porque deveras a ele aceitarei, para que eu não vos trate conforme a vossa loucura; porque vós não falastes de mim o que era reto como o meu servo Jó.

verses.original: וַיֵּלְכוּ֩ אֱלִיפַ֨ז הַתֵּֽימָנִ֜י וּבִלְדַּ֣ד הַשּׁוּחִ֗י צֹפַר֙ הַנַּ֣עֲמָתִ֔י וַֽיַּעֲשׂ֔וּ כַּאֲשֶׁ֛ר דִּבֶּ֥ר אֲלֵיהֶ֖ם יְהוָ֑ה וַיִּשָּׂ֥א יְהוָ֖ה אֶת־ פְּנֵ֥י אִיּֽוֹב׃
verses.transliteration: way·yê·lə·ḵū ’ĕ·lî·p̄az hat·tê·mā·nî ū·ḇil·daḏ haš·šū·ḥî ṣō·p̄ar han·na·‘ă·mā·ṯî way·ya·‘ă·śū ka·’ă·šer dib·ber ’ă·lê·hem Yah·weh way·yiś·śā Yah·weh ’eṯ- pə·nê ’î·yō·wḇ
verses.literal: So Eliphaz the Temanite Bildad the Shuhite and Zophar the Naamathite went and did as the LORD had told them . . . and the LORD accepted . . . Job’s prayer
verses.literalPt: Então foram Elifaz, o temanita, e Bildade, o suíta, e Zofar, o naamatita, e fizeram como o SENHOR lhes dissera; e o SENHOR aceitou a face de Jó.

verses.original: וַֽיהוָ֗ה שָׁ֚ב אֶת־ שְׁבִית אִיּ֔וֹב בְּהִֽתְפַּֽלְל֖וֹ בְּעַ֣ד רֵעֵ֑הוּ וַ֧יֹּסֶף יְהוָ֛ה אֶת־ כָּל־ אֲשֶׁ֥ר לְאִיּ֖וֹב לְמִשְׁנֶֽה׃
verses.transliteration: Yah·weh šāb̲ ’eṯ- šə·ḇīṯ ’î·yō·wḇ bə·hiṯ·pal·lōw bə·‘aḏ rê·‘ê·hū way·yō·sep̄ Yah·weh ’eṯ- kāl- ’ă·šer lə·’î·yō·wḇ lə·miš·neh
verses.literal: After Job had prayed for his friends the LORD restored his prosperity and doubled . . . - his former possessions
verses.literalPt: E o SENHOR virou o cativeiro de Jó, quando orava pelos seus amigos; e o SENHOR acrescentou, em dobro, a tudo quanto Jó antes possuía.

verses.original: וַיָּבֹ֣אוּ אֵ֠לָיו כָּל־ אֶחָ֨יו וְכָל־ אַחְיֹתָיו וְכָל־ יֹדְעָ֣יו לְפָנִ֗ים וַיֹּאכְל֨וּ עִמּ֣וֹ לֶחֶם֮ בְּבֵיתוֹ֒ וַיָּנֻ֤דוּ לוֹ֙ וַיְנַחֲמ֣וּ אֹת֔וֹ עַ֚ל כָּל־ הָ֣רָעָ֔ה אֲשֶׁר־ הֵבִ֥יא יְהוָ֖ה עָלָ֑יו וַיִּתְּנוּ־ ל֗וֹ אִ֚ישׁ קְשִׂיטָ֣ה אֶחָ֔ת וְאִ֕ישׁ נֶ֥זֶם זָהָ֖ב אֶחָֽד׃ס
verses.transliteration: way·yā·ḇō·’ū ’ê·lāw kāl- ’e·ḥāw wə·ḵāl ʾaḥ·yō·ṯå̄w wə·ḵāl yō·ḏə·‘āw lə·p̄ā·nîm way·yō·ḵə·lū ‘im·mōw le·ḥem bə·ḇê·ṯōw way·yā·nu·ḏū lōw way·na·ḥă·mū ’ō·ṯōw ‘al kāl- hā·rā·‘āh ’ă·šer- hê·ḇî Yah·weh ‘ā·lāw way·yit·tə·nū- lōw ’îš qə·śî·ṭāh ’e·ḥāṯ wə·’îš ne·zem zā·hāḇ ’e·ḥāḏ
verses.literal: All his brothers and sisters . . . and prior acquaintances came and dined . . . with him in his house They consoled him and comforted him over all the adversity that the LORD had brought upon him And each one gave him a . . . piece of silver and a gold ring
verses.literalPt: Então vieram a ele todos os seus irmãos, e todas as suas irmãs, e todos quantos dantes o conheceram, e comeram com ele pão em sua casa, e se condoeram dele, e o consolaram acerca de todo o mal que o SENHOR lhe havia enviado; e cada um deles lhe deu uma peça de dinheiro, e um pendente de ouro.

verses.original: וַֽיהוָ֗ה בֵּרַ֛ךְ אֶת־ אַחֲרִ֥ית אִיּ֖וֹב מֵרֵאשִׁת֑וֹ וַֽיְהִי־ ל֡וֹ אַרְבָּעָה֩ עָשָׂ֨ר אֶ֜לֶף צֹ֗אן וְשֵׁ֤שֶׁת אֲלָפִים֙ גְּמַלִּ֔ים וְאֶֽלֶף־ צֶ֥מֶד בָּקָ֖ר וְאֶ֥לֶף אֲתוֹנֽוֹת׃
verses.transliteration: Yah·weh bê·raḵ ’eṯ- ’a·ḥă·rîṯ ’î·yō·wḇ mê·rê·ši·ṯōw way·hî- lōw ’ar·bā·‘āh ‘ā·śār ’e·lep̄ ṣōn wə·šê·šeṯ ’ă·lā·p̄îm gə·mal·lîm wə·’e·lep̄- ṣe·meḏ bā·qār wə·’e·lep̄ ’ă·ṯō·w·nō·wṯ
verses.literal: So the LORD blessed Job’s latter days more than his first He owned 14,000 . . . . . . sheep 6,000 . . . camels 1,000 yoke of oxen and 1,000 female donkeys
verses.literalPt: E assim abençoou o SENHOR o último estado de Jó, mais do que o primeiro; pois teve catorze mil ovelhas, e seis mil camelos, e mil juntas de bois, e mil jumentas.

verses.original: וַֽיְהִי־ ל֛וֹ שִׁבְעָ֥נָה בָנִ֖ים וְשָׁל֥וֹשׁ בָּנֽוֹת׃
verses.transliteration: way·hî- lōw šiḇ·‘ā·nāh ḇā·nîm wə·šā·lō·wōš bā·nō·wṯ
verses.literal: And he also had seven sons and three daughters
verses.literalPt: Também teve sete filhos e três filhas.

verses.original: וַיִּקְרָ֤א שֵׁם־ הָֽאַחַת֙ יְמִימָ֔ה וְשֵׁ֥ם הַשֵּׁנִ֖ית קְצִיעָ֑ה וְשֵׁ֥ם הַשְּׁלִישִׁ֖ית קֶ֥רֶן הַפּֽוּךְ׃
verses.transliteration: way·yiq·rā šêm- hā·’a·ḥaṯ yə·mî·māh wə·šêm haš·šê·nîṯ qə·ṣî·‘āh wə·šêm haš·šə·lî·šîṯ qe·ren hap·pūḵ
verses.literal: He named . . . his first daughter Jemimah . . . his second Keziah . . . and his third Keren-happuch
verses.literalPt: E chamou o nome da primeira Jemima, e o nome da segunda Quezia, e o nome da terceira Quéren-Hapuque.

verses.original: וְלֹ֨א נִמְצָ֜א נָשִׁ֥ים יָפ֛וֹת כִּבְנ֥וֹת אִיּ֖וֹב בְּכָל־ הָאָ֑רֶץ וַיִּתֵּ֨ן לָהֶ֧ם אֲבִיהֶ֛ם נַחֲלָ֖ה בְּת֥וֹךְ אֲחֵיהֶֽם׃ס
verses.transliteration: wə·lō nim·ṣā nā·šîm yā·p̄ō·wṯ kiḇ·nō·wṯ ’î·yō·wḇ bə·ḵāl hā·’ā·reṣ way·yit·tên lā·hem ’ă·ḇî·hem na·ḥă·lāh bə·ṯō·wḵ ’ă·ḥê·hem
verses.literal: No women as beautiful as Job’s daughters could be found in all the land and their father granted them an inheritance among their brothers
verses.literalPt: E em toda a terra não se acharam mulheres tão formosas como as filhas de Jó; e seu pai lhes deu herança entre seus irmãos.

verses.original: וַיְחִ֤י אִיּוֹב֙ אַֽחֲרֵי־ זֹ֔את מֵאָ֥ה וְאַרְבָּעִ֖ים שָׁנָ֑ה וַיַּרְא אֶת־ בָּנָיו֙ וְאֶת־ בְּנֵ֣י בָנָ֔יו אַרְבָּעָ֖ה דֹּרֽוֹת׃
verses.transliteration: way·ḥî ’î·yō·wḇ ’a·ḥă·rê- zōṯ mê·’āh wə·’ar·bā·‘îm šā·nāh way·yar ’eṯ- bā·nāw wə·’eṯ- bə·nê ḇā·nāw ’ar·bā·‘āh dō·rō·wṯ
verses.literal: After this Job lived 140 . . . years and saw his children and their children to the fourth generation
verses.literalPt: E depois disto viveu Jó cento e quarenta anos; e viu a seus filhos, e aos filhos de seus filhos, até à quarta geração.

verses.literal: And so Job died old and full of years
verses.literalPt: Então morreu Jó, velho e farto de dias.
